steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk mashed banana, eggs, plain yogurt, canola oil, and vanilla in a large bowl.
Add chickpea flour and baking powder to the bowl.
Stir gently until just combined; do not overwork the batter.
Fold in blueberries with a spatula, distributing evenly.
Divide batter equally among the 12 muffin cups, filling each three-quarters full.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 2 days, or refrigerate for 5 days.
